facts.title: Pumpkin Pecan Scones with Maple Glaze
ingredients: 2 cups (250 grams) white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour
¼ teaspoon ground cloves or allspice
⅓ cup solid coconut oil* or 5 tablespoons cold butter
¼ cup milk of choice (almond milk, cow’s milk, etc.)
1 tablespoon melted coconut oil or butter
¼ cup maple syrup, more if needed
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
